rows.title: broad baseline / measurement
rows.developmentTarget: fresh, compatible paired development bases and residual attribution where needed
rows.limitation: one-model screen; missing stage attribution, incomplete usage, no human calibration; pre-change fabric arms cannot be mixed with current arms

rows.title: enrichment and navigation
rows.developmentTarget: full LongMemEval-M and BEAM-1M cohorts, separate enrichment/navigation ablations, frozen candidate-gap rules and the ability veto
rows.limitation: halving missed in every measurable suite; ability regressions descriptive; MAB fine recall inconclusive

rows.title: timeline
rows.developmentTarget: temporal strata and applicable baseline-model comparisons
rows.limitation: free one-model diagnostic, not the baseline-model/multi-model target

rows.title: state grouping / opt-in wrapper
rows.developmentTarget: calibrate grouping, separately cost the wrapper, diagnose residual state failures
rows.limitation: functional tests only; provisional exchange subject Dice floor 0.5; StateMemBench unavailable (dataset coverage recorded as unavailable)

rows.title: passive delivery
rows.developmentTarget: irrelevant rate <= 0.40, injected tokens -50%, 2-point non-inferiority, small-model no-harm
rows.limitation: functional tests only; 0.2/0.35 floors lack a development benefit row

rows.title: aggregation / abstention
rows.developmentTarget: answer-gap -40%, abstention >= full, residual attribution with delivered evidence and read-time/oracle controls

rows.title: weak-tool-caller adaptation
rows.developmentTarget: realistic multi-turn weak-caller probe; small model >= passive and within 5 points of full; strong model 2-point no-harm; run-limit share
rows.limitation: fresh one-question sessions do not exercise the two-turn trigger

rows.title: coding decisions
rows.limitation: functional tests and cue timing; no model-run 12-persona/MemoryCode/VibeMemBench row

rows.title: decision gates P1-P7
rows.developmentTarget: each point separately: accuracy, ECE, order flip, latency, cost, calibration, end-to-end no-harm, trust-scan recall
rows.limitation: synthetic fixture only; no point passed its live bench; thresholds provisional

rows.title: typed-link association
rows.developmentTarget: reconsider only on complete >= 5% shared-entity/not-in-query residual attribution
rows.limitation: closed without implementation; causal association attribution insufficient; no graph store

rows.title: safety
rows.developmentTarget: confirm agentic poisoning with a real model; rerun safety on the final product
rows.limitation: offline pass with a deterministic follower mock; no real-model MINJA confirmation

rows.title: growth and scale
rows.developmentTarget: retain the measured capacity/cost role with scope; final-product growth criterion and model-answer confirmation
rows.limitation: offline retrieval, not generated-answer accuracy; hardware-specific performance

rows.title: OM and promotion
rows.developmentTarget: full development QA and live promotion benefit if pursued
rows.limitation: synthetic role comparison; zero later cited promoted notes; live arms prove completion only

rows.title: facts / F4
rows.developmentTarget: conditional residual diagnosis: < 5% complete attribution -> not-needed; >= 5% irrecoverable -> fix-and-measure the scoped remedy; incomplete -> unmeasured, no preset
rows.limitation: facts preset unbuilt; F4 unresolved; no causal residual evidence from Tasks 7/9
